items.html: And behold, when Adam HaRishon sinned, the world was overturned, and he caused a blemish in the four holy worlds, and caused a correction in the four worlds of the Klipa. And this is their matter: for behold, through the sin of Adam HaRishon, the blemish reached, in the world of Atzilut, up to AA of holiness, as it were. And this is the secret of 'He made darkness His hiding-place.' And then AA of Atzilut does not illuminate, but is hidden within Aba and Ima, and Aba and Ima illuminate in Atzilut, and AA illuminates through them, from within them. And this is one blemish.
